description.value: Grand Noodle Emporium is an AMS-owned and operated pan-Asian restaurant located in the Lower Level of the Nest at UBC Vancouver, seating up to 60 guests. It serves made-to-order comfort dishes spanning Chinese, Thai, and Southeast Asian cuisines — think Pad Thai and Thai curry alongside classic Chinese take-out from a concourse window. It also offers catering and online ordering for pickup, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the UBC campus.
